data_boundaries: PostgreSQL owns user-editable platform data and chat/session state.
one_corpus_web /api/v1/* normally proxies to opc-bot on 127.0.0.1:8081.

evidence_layers.strong_signal: Report states local/test/staging/prod and mock/seed/real data boundary before pass/fail.
evidence_layers.weak_signal_to_avoid: A generic pass/fail without naming the runtime data boundary.

evidence_layers.strong_signal: Visible catalog state is tied to current UI/API/seed evidence.
evidence_layers.weak_signal_to_avoid: Treating hardcoded cards or local seed rows as online production configuration.

evidence_layers.strong_signal: Rendered reply is identified as real stream output or explicitly labeled fallback/optimistic UI.
evidence_layers.weak_signal_to_avoid: Counting fallback text as backend completion.

evidence_layers.strong_signal: WebSocket/SSE/HTTP stream emits a terminal event for the same run marker.
evidence_layers.weak_signal_to_avoid: Matching the unique marker only in user input or prompt text.

evidence_layers.strong_signal: Read-only persistence/log evidence shows the same session/turn reaches completed.
evidence_layers.weak_signal_to_avoid: Inferring DB completion from a successful screenshot.
